name: exact_permit testnet (BSC testnet, real chain settlement)

steps.name: start example facilitator
steps.command: @start_bg facilitator env FACILITATOR_PORT=8013 FACILITATOR_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY=${BSC_TESTNET_FACILITATOR_KEY} FACILITATOR_EVM_NETWORKS=eip155:97 FACILITATOR_EVM_SCHEMES=exact_permit BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL=${BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL:-} python3 -m examples.facilitator

steps.name: start resource server (exact_permit on BSC testnet)
steps.command: @start_bg resource-server env E2E_NETWORK=eip155:97 E2E_SCHEMES=exact_permit E2E_SERVER_PORT=8012 E2E_FACILITATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8013 E2E_PAY_TO=${BSC_TESTNET_PAY_TO} E2E_ASSET_PRICE=${BSC_TESTNET_PERMIT_PRICE:-0.0001 USDT} python3 -m e2e.servers.resource_server

steps.name: client: pay with real signature + on-chain settlement
steps.command: env E2E_NETWORK=eip155:97 E2E_SCHEMES=exact_permit E2E_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8012 E2E_ENDPOINT=/protected E2E_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY=${BSC_TESTNET_CLIENT_KEY} E2E_OUTPUT=/tmp/x402-e2e-exact-permit-testnet-response.json E2E_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=120 python3 -m e2e.clients.test_client

steps.name: assert payment succeeded + tx hash present
